issues.title: Retry policy for failed batch loads
issues.description:
## Goal
Define one retry policy for failed batch loads.

## Proposal
Retry 3 times with exponential backoff, then page on-call.
issues.author: alex

notes.author: alex
notes.body: I prefer 5 retries; transient storage errors often last longer than three attempts.

notes.author: robin
notes.body: 5 retries delays the page by 30 minutes. We agreed in planning that paging within 10 minutes matters more.

notes.author: alex
notes.body: @sam you own the loader: can it tell transient errors from permanent ones? That would settle this.
